clock: Node: file write resolved -> list/translation ack received; selection-ready request received -> translation ack. Browser: before setLocale -> translation commit. Never subtract clocks across processes.
acknowledgement: Includes HTTP acknowledgement cost. Control round trip is reported separately, never subtracted or added to stage p95s.
scope: Fresh en-GB directory and catalog per round; directory creation excluded from file-save latency. List option commit then automated locale selection; target never loaded before list ack. Reset to en and await locale removal before next round. React development, no paint timing.

runtimeStages.scope: Node diagnostic only. sample covers stage begin before write to stage finish after ack receipt; locale ends at list ack, excludes selection/reset/removal. Timestamp intersections, not causal attribution or CPU time. candidateOther contains baseStat. GC and late-timer intervals can overlap; never subtract/add them or nested stage quantiles. Timer lateness includes synchronous JS, GC, I/O callback work and OS scheduling. Asynchronous GC delivery flushed after final ack; not a stop-the-world trace.

serverStages.scope: Benchmark-only method wrappers before list DOM ack. queueToDrain is the first batch queue wait; per-batch waits are retained in drainWaitMs. readAndCandidate is the union of all batch windows, including serialized wait; each closes at its own prepareTranslations, or promise settlement for superseded/error batches. Excludes boot, locale selection and removal. translationPreparation includes schema lookup, validation and quarantine. Boundary v1 overwrote the start on later drains; do not compare those candidate or queue metrics directly. Do not add nested p95s.

serverFileStages.scope: Benchmark-only in-memory Node module transform. Multiple completed reads and failed attempts are retained. Each file stage is the union of its operation intervals; all operations must fit the candidate union. candidateOther is the candidate interval union minus the union of all file operations. Unfinished/missing operations fail. Do not add nested quantiles or treat wall times as CPU times.
